main_text.p: Ebn Batrik ] سعيد بن البطريق Said EbnolBatrik qui & Εὐτύχιος [?] Eutysius, seu Eutychius appellatus: natus anno H. 223. mortuus 328. Hist. Medic.
153.Ebn Chalawaib ] ابو عبد الله الحسين بن احمد بن خالويه Abu Abdollahi AlHosain Ebn Ahmed Ebn Chalawaib, obiit anno H 370. Ebn Chal. Mizb.
154.Ebn Hashem leg. Hefham ابو محمد عبد الملك بن هشام Abu Mohammed Abdelmalec Ebn Hefham obiit anno H. 213. juxta alios 218. librum composuit de انساب حمير وملوكها Hamyarensium genealogiis & regibus.
Author libri جامع اللغة Lexicon è Sehabol lauharii, Mogreb AlMotarrezii, AlZamachsharío aliisque concinnatum, authore incerto.

157.AlBochariu ] ابو عبد الله محمد بن ابي الحسن اسماعيل البخاري Abu Abdollah Mohammed Ebn AbilHasan Ismaelis, AlBochari, seu Bocharensis, patriam scil. habens بخارا Bochara, natus anno H. 194. mortuus 256. Ebn Chalec. & epit. Tasei, at Alliannabi, natus annos 72. scribendum fors. 62.

158.Ebn Moklab ] ابو علي محمد بن علي بن الحسن بن مقلة Abu Ali Mohammed Ebn Ali EbnolHasan Ebn Moklab, à principe quodam quem apud Chalifam detulerat, quò ipse imperii rebus præficeretur, dextra truncatus est. natus est anno H. 271. mortuus 328.
Ali Ebn Bowab ] ابو الحسين علي بن هلال المعروف بابن البواب الكاتب Abul Hosain Ali Ebn Halal qui vulgo appellatur EbnolBowab AlCateb, i. e. Scriba

page.notes: Greek word after "&" in the Batrik entry is not fully legible; reading Εὐτύχιος is doubtful. Long s has been normalised to s throughout (printed forms such as "Hafan", "Hofain", "Hafhem", "Tafei", "feribendum", "forf." appear to be long s). The Arabic is transcribed from the scan with best effort; individual diacritics and some letters are uncertain and not marked individually. Printed "Chal." and "Mizb." abbreviations kept as printed. Entry numbers 153, 154, 157, 158 are marginal notes on the left.
